claims.text: A young woman presented with multiple nevi that began on the buttocks and spread to the back and legs over the previous 2 months. Examination showed hundreds of small dome-shaped reddish brown nevi on the legs and upper body, with a few newly formed lesions on the neck. She had no itching, bleeding, facial freckling or reported photosensitivity, no drug use, and no family genetic disease.
